verdict.description: Spec section 6 fixes all three and what each does to the graph. supported -> verdict recorded, confidence recomputed. unsupported -> demoted to an open assumption, a search task spawned. contradicted -> refuted, and if an assumption rested on it the invalidation cascade runs.

failing_citations.description: Supporting citations from the input packet that the verifier judges do not actually support the claim. Marked `rejected`, which drops them from live_citations and lowers the score. Naming a `counter` citation here is not honoured: a counter citation is evidence against the claim, and the verifier's job is to judge the claim, not erase opposition.

reasoning.description: Journaled verbatim. 'Why is H-012 refuted' must be answerable three days later.
